analogy.rationale: Insulin sensitizers act on ACACB/PRKAB1 (AMPK-related) to modulate lipid/glucose metabolism, a program these cell lines largely lack; PPAR agonists share downstream metabolic gene regulation but require PPAR expression, so responses should be weak. Other metabolic classes are included as low-similarity alternatives.
